decisions.reason: As a safety shoe line building directly on the firm's core protective footwear knowledge and internal product development, it is easy to interpret results and improve.
Comfort insoles relate to existing footwear and foot-measurement expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the product.
Supportive insoles similarly extend the firm's foot-related knowledge, so early results can be understood and acted upon.
Ergonomic safety shoes are an incremental extension of established safety shoe know-how, supporting learning and retention.
Firefighter and rescue boots, while somewhat more specialized, still build on protective footwear and materials knowledge plus internal R&D, so the firm can learn from early results.
As the flagship moulded insole focused on the firm's direction, it is closely tied to existing foot-measurement and component knowledge and is strongly retained.
